question: How do siddha-siddha and siddha-sādhya mantra classifications differ in required recitation?
premises: A siddha-siddha mantra succeeds through recitation.
A siddha-sādhya mantra succeeds through double the recitation.
inference: The siddha-sādhya classification requires twice the recitation effort of siddha-siddha.
plain_english: A siddha-siddha mantra succeeds through recitation, while a siddha-sādhya mantra succeeds through double the recitation.
